name: Anime and Manga: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Anime and Manga look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, anime key visual, thin clean line art, large detailed eyes with layered highlights, hair drawn as bold separate clumps, hard-edged cel shading with one shadow tone, saturated flat colour, crisp rim light, painted sky gradients
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, western cartoon, heavy outlines, extra fingers, blurry, text, watermark
